تبريد الغلاية وفك 
 الصاج وازالة العزل الحرارى وذلك فى منطقة بعيدة عن الحرارة 
 (الاماكن المطلوب العمل فيها)
ازالة العزل حول مجمعى المحمص النهائى (دخول وخروج)

عند تصفية الغلاية من الماء يتم تقطيع 
 علبتى العزل لمجمعى الدخول والخروج للمحمص النهائى وازالة 
 الصوف والخرسانة الحرارية حول 
وصلة لحام

عمل 
قفل 
 خاص 
 التوتر عقد الربيع 
 وذلك من دواعى الامن حيث عند قطع الملفات سوف ينقص الوزن مما 
 يؤثر على
 عقد الربيع

ازالة الطوب الحرارى من ارضية المحمص وكذلك الجزء المقطوع من 
 ستائر ارضية الفرن (غرفة اللهب)

تقطيع ما يعوق مرور الملفات عند اخراجها بعد تقطيعها (مواسير 
 من ستائر غرف اللهب - قطع ماسورتين من مواسير ملئ الغلاية بطول 
 2.5 متر)

تجهيز الوصلة الخاصة بإنزال الملفات (ملفات المحمص) من الغلاية 
 بطريقة آمنة وتلافى حدوث 
 أى تلف بالغلاية

قطع 
 ملفات المحمص من مجمعى الدخول والخروج عند المكان المخصص لذلك
انزال الملفات واخلائها من الغلاية

يتم تجهيز اماكن القطع بعمل 
طحن 
 قبل بدء اللحام عند مجمعى الدخول والخروج كما يتم فى نفس وقت 
 تجهيز الملفات الجديدة للحام بعد اخذ الاطوال وضبط الخلوصات

اثناء ذلك تم استعدال مواسير ارضية المحمص النهائى التى حدث 
 لها ترخيم اثناء التشغيل

يتم 
 رفع الملفات الجديدة بالتجهيزة الخاصة لذلك مع مراعة وضع الملف 
 فى الاتجاة الصحيح وقياس الخلوص بين سقف المحمص وارضيتة هتى 
 يتم اللحام بافضل ما يمكن

يراعى عند تركيب 
 الملفات ان تكون بداية التركيب من جانبى الغلاية والوصول للملف 
 رقم 22 من الناحية الجنوبية مكان الملف مجهز بتجهيزة خاصة لكى 
 يكون اخر ملف يتم تركيبة

Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: Blr-005-r0a
Equipment: Boiler vertical superheater coils, Steam Boilers Company
Issued to: Assiut Steam 3*30
Status: APPROVED
Approval date: 07 June 2007
Procedure:

sections_en.text: This document sets out the steps for replacing the secondary superheater coils of unit No. (1).

The first draft was prepared by Eng. Wael Abdel Razek Sayed, tested by Eng. Romany Naguib, approved by Eng. Mostafa Zahran, and endorsed by Eng. Hussein Ahmed Ahmed, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at Assiut Steam.
Isolate the boiler whose vertical superheater coils are to be replaced
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and the maintenance crew must carry the industrial safety category card
Record the names of the workers in the work order and their industrial safety categories
Define the work area of the equipment and place warning signs indicating that work is being carried out
Workers must wear the necessary industrial safety and safety equipment while carrying out the work, such as the helmet, gloves, masks and protective shoes
Take all safety precautions when erecting the required scaffolds

items: Isolate the boiler whose vertical superheater coils are to be replaced
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and the maintenance crew must carry the industrial safety category card
Record the names of the workers in the work order and their industrial safety categories
Define the work area of the equipment and place warning signs indicating that work is being carried out
Workers must wear the necessary industrial safety and safety equipment while carrying out the work, such as the helmet, gloves, masks and protective shoes
Take all safety precautions when erecting the required scaffolds

sections_en.text: Complete open-end spanner set and complete ring spanner set – chisel and hammer set
Special tool for lowering and raising the coils
Chain block 1 ton and also chain block 2 tons with lifting wires
Cutting discs, cutting stones, welding machines, argon cylinders, oxygen cylinders, acetylene cylinders and welding wire
Electrical connection boards for the welding machines – electric floodlights

items: Complete open-end spanner set and complete ring spanner set – chisel and hammer set
Special tool for lowering and raising the coils
Chain block 1 ton and also chain block 2 tons with lifting wires
Cutting discs, cutting stones, welding machines, argon cylinders, oxygen cylinders, acetylene cylinders and welding wire
Electrical connection boards for the welding machines – electric floodlights

rows: Cool the boiler, remove the sheet metal and remove the thermal insulation in an area away from the heat (the places where work is required)
Remove the insulation around the final superheater headers (inlet and outlet)
When draining the boiler of water, cut the insulation boxes of the inlet and outlet headers of the final superheater and remove the wool and the refractory concrete around the weld joint
Make a special lock for the spring-hanger tension, for safety, since when the coils are cut the weight will decrease, which affects the spring hangers
Remove the refractory bricks from the superheater floor, as well as the cut part of the furnace floor curtains (flame chamber)
Cut whatever obstructs the passage of the coils when they are removed after cutting (pipes from the flame chamber curtains – cut two pipes of the boiler filling pipes, 2.5 m long)
Prepare the connection for lowering the (superheater) coils from the boiler safely, avoiding any damage to the boiler
Cut the superheater coils from the inlet and outlet headers at the designated place
Lower the coils and remove them from the boiler

Prepare the cutting places by grinding before starting welding at the inlet and outlet headers, and at the same time prepare the new coils for welding after taking the lengths and adjusting the clearances
Meanwhile, the final superheater floor tubes that had sagged during operation were straightened

Lift the new coils with the special rigging, taking care to place the coil in the correct direction and measure the clearance between the superheater roof and floor so that welding is done in the best possible way

When fitting the coils, start fitting from both sides of the boiler and reach coil No. 22 from the southern side, where the coil position is fitted with a special rigging so that it is the last coil to be fitted

This document sets out the steps for replacing the secondary superheater coils of unit No. (1).
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Wael Abdel Razek Sayed, tested by Eng. Romany Naguib, approved by Eng. Mostafa Zahran, and endorsed by Eng. Hussein Ahmed Ahmed, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at Assiut Steam.
Isolate the boiler whose vertical superheater coils are to be replaced
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and the maintenance crew must carry the industrial safety category card
Record the names of the workers in the work order and their industrial safety categories
Define the work area of the equipment and place warning signs indicating that work is being carried out
Workers must wear the necessary industrial safety and safety equipment while carrying out the work, such as the helmet, gloves, masks and protective shoes
Take all safety precautions when erecting the required scaffolds
Isolate the boiler whose vertical superheater coils are to be replaced
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and the maintenance crew must carry the industrial safety category card
Record the names of the workers in the work order and their industrial safety categories
Define the work area of the equipment and place warning signs indicating that work is being carried out
Workers must wear the necessary industrial safety and safety equipment while carrying out the work, such as the helmet, gloves, masks and protective shoes
Take all safety precautions when erecting the required scaffolds
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Complete open-end spanner set and complete ring spanner set – chisel and hammer set
Special tool for lowering and raising the coils
Chain block 1 ton and also chain block 2 tons with lifting wires
Cutting discs, cutting stones, welding machines, argon cylinders, oxygen cylinders, acetylene cylinders and welding wire
Electrical connection boards for the welding machines – electric floodlights
Complete open-end spanner set and complete ring spanner set – chisel and hammer set
Special tool for lowering and raising the coils
Chain block 1 ton and also chain block 2 tons with lifting wires
Cutting discs, cutting stones, welding machines, argon cylinders, oxygen cylinders, acetylene cylinders and welding wire
Electrical connection boards for the welding machines – electric floodlights
Procedures to be Carried Out
Cool the boiler, remove the sheet metal and remove the thermal insulation in an area away from the heat (the places where work is required) | 1.
Remove the insulation around the final superheater headers (inlet and outlet) | 2.
When draining the boiler of water, cut the insulation boxes of the inlet and outlet headers of the final superheater and remove the wool and the refractory concrete around the weld joint | 3.
Make a special lock for the spring-hanger tension, for safety, since when the coils are cut the weight will decrease, which affects the spring hangers | 4.
Remove the refractory bricks from the superheater floor, as well as the cut part of the furnace floor curtains (flame chamber) | 5.
Cut whatever obstructs the passage of the coils when they are removed after cutting (pipes from the flame chamber curtains – cut two pipes of the boiler filling pipes, 2.5 m long) | 6.
Prepare the connection for lowering the (superheater) coils from the boiler safely, avoiding any damage to the boiler | 7.
Cut the superheater coils from the inlet and outlet headers at the designated place | 8.
Lower the coils and remove them from the boiler | 9.
Prepare the cutting places by grinding before starting welding at the inlet and outlet headers, and at the same time prepare the new coils for welding after taking the lengths and adjusting the clearances | 10
Meanwhile, the final superheater floor tubes that had sagged during operation were straightened | 11.
Lift the new coils with the special rigging, taking care to place the coil in the correct direction and measure the clearance between the superheater roof and floor so that welding is done in the best possible way | 12.
When fitting the coils, start fitting from both sides of the boiler and reach coil No. 22 from the southern side, where the coil position is fitted with a special rigging so that it is the last coil to be fitted | 13.
